license.local_modifications: Simplification, topology-preserving coordinate precision reduction, code matching and label points for HERMES dashboard display.

source.method: Exact ten-digit adm_cd2 match to bundled I5 dong registry across included months; geometry simplified with topology preservation and valid-output precision reduction. Display only features whose code is present in the selected month registry. No geometry is fabricated for missing codes.
source.names: Bundled I5 registry names selected by exact code, using latest included month; source spelling variants do not change code matching.
source.labels: Point-on-surface of final simplified geometry; longitude, latitude.
